market.summary: India reopens after the holiday with GIFT Nifty pointing to a firm start (+237 points), catching up with Monday's big US rally. But the US gave some back on Tuesday (Nasdaq -1.5% on a chip sell-off) and Asia is falling hard this morning (Kospi -5%, Nikkei -2.9%), so the gap-up may not hold. Monday's close still sets every stop until today's close; US inflation data comes out at 7 pm IST.

points.text: US, Tue 24 Nov: Dow +0.85% to 50,019 (first close above 50,000), S&P 500 -0.50% to 7,201, Nasdaq -1.48% to 23,734 as chip and AI stocks gave back part of Monday's rally and money rotated into value names.

Wed 25 Nov 8:34 IST: GIFT Nifty 25,738.5, up 237 points (it catches up with two US sessions since Monday's Indian close); Kospi -5% and Nikkei -2.9% as the AI trade unwinds in Asia; Brent $88.16 (-0.4%), near its lowest since late August.
US, Mon 23 Nov: Nasdaq +6.5%, S&P 500 +4.7% after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO.
Last flows (Mon 23 Nov, provisional): FIIs bought Rs 5,673 Cr, DIIs sold Rs 2,760 Cr; no trading or flows on the 24 Nov holiday.
US October PCE inflation, Q3 GDP (second estimate) and jobless claims are due today at 8:30 am ET (7 pm IST); US markets shut Thursday for Thanksgiving.
